what: The step row advances one cell every two beats. The line joining the previous and next step is drawn in one beat, then the next step becomes ‹Now› and its box bounces from 1.15× into place in half a beat. Past steps read ‹Done› and remaining steps read ‹Next›. It pauses when off-screen.

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)

use:
1. Step 1
  2. …
    3. …
— state is li[data-state=done|current|ahead]
